final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), above_average AS (SELECT rating, copies, AVG(copies) OVER () AS overall_avg FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(copies) AS total_copies, AVG(copies - overall_avg) AS average_excess FROM above_average WHERE copies > overall_avg
